decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Letter from Barton Willmore dated 29 August 2014 Received: 02 September 2014 
D378 DWG 212, SJ 348, Archaeological Desk Based Assessment to 1838AD Received: 03 September 2014 Figure 7: 2011 Ordnance Survey Received: 04 September 2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - When the premises cease to be occupied by World Class Teachers, the A2 use hereby permitted shall cease.
Condition : 4 - No amplified music or other music shall be played outside the commercial premises hereby approved within the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The commercial uses hereby approved shall only be open to the public between the hours of 07:00am to 07:00pm Monday to Friday and shall not be open on Saturdays, Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays.
description: Change of use of former waterworks listed building to A1/ A2/ A3/ B1(a)/ B1(b) use
